entities.name: Johann Baptist von Lampi the Elder

entities.summary: Johann Baptist von Lampi the Elder was a historical and portrait painter. He settled in the Russian Empire after the third and final partition of Poland, enticed by an extremely generous offer from Tsar Paul I of Russia.
